paper.title_en: Krylov complexity of a massless scalar field in massive BTZ black hole with quantum fluctuation
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the Krylov complexity of the massless scalar field in the massive Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) black hole with quantum fluctuation. This fluctuation is considered to be triggered by the Hawking radiation, which indeed influences the behavior of the time evolution of Krylov complexity. Our results show that Lanczos coefficients bn exhibit a black hole mass M-dependent staggering, <math altimg="si7.svg"><mrow><mstyle mathvariant="normal"><mi>Δ</mi></mstyle><mover><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>N</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="true">‾</mo></mover><mo>∼</mo><mi>M</mi></mrow></math>, inducing oscillatory complexity dynamics that intensify with lower mass black holes. Moreover, the graviton mass m is found to suppress the oscillations but accelerate the late-time exponential growth <math altimg="si8.svg"><mrow><mi>K</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>∼</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><msub><mi>λ</mi><mi>K</mi></msub><mi>t</mi></mrow></msup></mrow></math>. This study indicates that the Krylov complexity could be a sensitive probe to distinguish massless and massive gravity via operator growth signatures.
